PC: Performed a focused history based on complaint
Perform focused history and physical exam based on degree of extremis
Initiates resuscitation including IV/IO access and oxygen supplementation
Obtain access and initiate normal saline fluid resuscitation

Appropriate development of differential diagnosis of critical neonate

Appropriate disposition to ICU with cardiac care capabilities
